description:
Read one narrative disclosure

Returns a single disclosure and its narrative text. The filer's markup is stripped before storage, so `disclosure_text` is plain text.

Identifiers come from `/v1/edgar/companies/{cik}/disclosures`. An unknown identifier answers 404 `EDGAR_DISCLOSURE_NOT_FOUND`.

disclosure_id.description: Disclosure identifier from the company listing.

name: edgar_disclosures
